An '''Imperial officer''' was a commander of [[115th]], a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The unit fought in the [[Battle of Corellia]] where it was stationed at the [[Islands Outpost]]. During the battle [[Darth Thanaton]] relieved the commander and put his own apprentice [[Skar (Sith)|Skar]] in charge of the unit.<ref name="First Strike">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|First Strike|Corellia}}</ref>
